purpose: Teach: 燃やし/とうてい/しかるべき/思い通り/のべ/いちおう/かならず/みごと

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: 翔くん、メイ姉さんが、いっしょに枯葉を燃やしましょうね
lines.en: Sho, let's burn those fallen leaves together, okay?
lines.style: Soft, warm opening. Slight musical lilt on his name. Gentle invitation — not commanding, genuinely wanting his company. Breath carries affection.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: メイ姉さん、ぼく、お父さんみたいにとうてい走れないよ
lines.en: Mei-sis… I can't run like Dad does, no matter what.
lines.style: Small, matter-of-fact voice. A quiet worry disguised as observation. No self-pity, just honest assessment. Slight pause before the 'no matter what,' like he's accepted it.

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: 翔くん、お友達同士の喧嘩は、しかるべき大人に相談ね
lines.en: Sho, if you and your friends have a fight, you should talk to a trusted adult about it, okay?
lines.style: Gentle but clear guidance. Not lecturing — checking in. Warm maternal tone, but with the quiet steadiness of someone who's seen this before. Slight lift at the end, inviting agreement.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: メイ姉さん、ぼく、思い通りに絵が描けたよ
lines.en: Mei-sis… I drew a picture the way I wanted it to!
lines.style: Quick, bright energy. Pride breaking through his usual quiet. Voice lifts on the final phrase. Small but genuine excitement — he's sharing something he made.

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: 翔くん、メイ姉さんと、のべ五日もお出かけしたわね
lines.en: Sho, we went out together for five whole days, didn't we?
lines.style: Warm, slightly wistful recollection. Gentle teasing affection in the counting. Unhurried pace. The tone of someone savoring a memory that mattered.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: メイ姉さん、ぼく、いちおうお手伝いはしたよ
lines.en: Mei-sis… I did help out, at least a little bit.
lines.style: Quiet earnestness. Small defensive edge — not rude, just needing to be seen. Careful precision on 'at least a little bit,' like he's being honest about his own effort.

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: 翔くん、メイ姉さんはかならずお迎えに来るわね
lines.en: Sho, I'll always come pick you up, I promise.
lines.style: Steady, absolute conviction. No hesitation. The kind of promise spoken into permanence. Breath is even, centered. This is not a casual statement.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: メイ姉さん、ぼく、運動会でみごとに一等賞だったよ
lines.en: Mei-sis… I came in first place at the sports day!
lines.style: Quiet triumph breaking through his usual reserve. Voice cracks slightly with genuine pride. Quick, unpracticed excitement — he can't quite hide how much this means. Warmth toward her in the telling.
